project.name: Baobab ERP Mapping Bundle
project.description: Reads CanonicalEntity/ExternalReference mappings to translate canonical identifiers into iDempiere native record keys (C_BPartner, M_Product, M_Warehouse, ...) and back, per ADR-ERP-007. Never treats an iDempiere ID as a canonical ID.
